```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
```

## Overview

This analysis examines the results of the 2026 Florida Republican primary election for Governor using precinct-level voting data.

```{r}
#| label: load-data
# Ensure the precinct data files are extracted
if (!dir.exists("data")) {
  unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = "data")
}

files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read precinct-level results selecting county, office, district, candidate, party, and vote count
election_data <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_select = c(2, 12, 13, 15, 16, 19)
) |>
  set_names(c("county_name", "office", "district", "candidate", "party", "votes"))
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-republican-governor
# Aggregate total votes for Republican gubernatorial candidates
rep_gov <- election_data |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party == "REP") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)

# Create a horizontal bar chart of vote totals
ggplot(rep_gov, aes(x = total_votes, y = reorder(candidate, total_votes))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Total votes cast by candidate across all Florida counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Congressional Races in South Florida

This bubble chart displays all candidates running for the U.S. House of Representatives in Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, and Monroe counties. Bubble size indicates votes received in each county.

```{r}
#| label: plot-congress-bubbles
#| fig-height: 11
#| fig-width: 9

target_counties <- c("Broward", "Miami-Dade", "Monroe", "Palm Beach")

congress_data <- election_data |>
  filter(
    county_name %in% target_counties,
    office == "Representative in Congress",
    !candidate %in% c("OverVotes", "UnderVotes")
  ) |>
  summarize(
    votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(county_name, district, candidate, party)
  ) |>
  mutate(candidate_label = paste0(candidate, " (", district, ")"))

ggplot(
  congress_data,
  aes(
    x = factor(county_name, levels = target_counties),
    y = fct_reorder(candidate_label, votes, .fun = sum),
    size = votes,
    color = party
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 8, labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DEM" = "#2E5B88", "REP" = "#D9534F")) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Candidates for U.S. House of Representatives",
    subtitle = "2026 Primary Election votes across South Florida counties",
    x = "County",
    y = "Candidate",
    size = "Votes Cast",
    color = "Party",
    caption = "Note: Monroe County (District 28) had no contested primary for Representative in Congress."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
